warnings: The daily host dataset is elite, rating-selected and capped; it is not an unbiased ladder sample.
Manifest scores are episode-level and must not be attributed to one seat or deck.
Replay action at step t belongs to the preceding active agent request, not the same observation record.
The top-level replay id is an internal UUID; the Kaggle episode id is the filename.
Actions are decoded for structural and meta analysis but remain unauthorized as imitation-learning supervision.
A complete audit corrected the semantic metadata provenance hash; coverage and action alignment were unchanged, and the corrected stream passed repeat and independent review.
approved_next_action: Use the closed R1 loader for deterministic replay and meta diagnostics. Do not retrieve additional episodes or use replay actions for training without a new decision; rebuild the G2 qualification bundle from the latest clean source and run bounded private Kaggle CPU/GPU qualification.
